contract_extensions_and_deviations: learned-choice: optional extra parameters tie_break, max_sessions, and context.sources (alternative to context.q); feature_set v2 (contract allows an optional v2). The contract's {p, q} schema is implemented exactly; nothing in the contract interface changed.
learned-choice: feature_set and theta are required; seed optional (absent -> fresh entropy, nondeterministic); harness must always pass seed.
learned-choice: feature 0 always uses KvRouterConfig::default() score weights (task directive), independent of router_config knobs; the role structure comes from the host config.
learned-choice and sticky-session: default tie-break is one_draw (LR-03), so theta0 matches the seeded default only up to ties; exact replay parity needs tie_break: reservoir (verified identical).

sticky-session: accepts seed and tie_break (not in the contract list) so the A1 protocol's policy seed k+1 applies; mode required; load_factor with mode hard is a startup error; bounded load_factor must be finite >= 1.0.
sticky-session: the fallback default cost fn uses the HOST config (router_config knobs such as overlap_score_credit and router_temperature tune it), mirroring dynamo-default-cost-fn.
Both new pickers, like the plugin default picker, ignore the per-request router_temperature override (see UPSTREAM_FOLLOWUPS #4); replay never sets one.

learned-choice.composition: WorkerSelectionPolicy::new(host config, role.default_selector_label(), [default cost scorer built by default::cost_scorer at KvRouterConfig::default() weights], LearnedChoicePicker).with_exclusive_affinity(true). Feature 0 is the composed scorer's cost, so CACHE, LOAD and PREFERRED_TAINT are handled by the default scorer's own code.
context_sources: is_first_turn (1 when no remembered previous worker for the session, incl. no session)
learned-choice.decision: temperature 0: argmax u, ties by seeded RNG over canonical worker order; temperature > 0: sample softmax(u/temperature) with the seeded RNG; host pin wins (row of pinned worker) and rebinds the session; non-finite utility -> selection error
learned-choice.declared_inputs: picker CACHE|LOAD; composed default scorer LOAD|PREFERRED_TAINT|CACHE. Never reads expected_output_tokens or PREFILL_TIME.
feature_set_v1: 0 default_logit_scaled = default cost (KvRouterConfig::default() weights, incl. preferred-taint multiplier) / max(request_blocks,1)
4 kv_load_frac = decode_cost_blocks / worker_capacity().total_kv_blocks() (fallback 65536 when not advertised; replay advertises num_gpu_blocks per setup)
6 session_affinity = 1 if this worker served the session's previous request (policy LRU map keyed by session_context().session_id(), bound max_sessions), else 0
feature_set_v2_appended: 11 hash_home = 1 if among the top-2 rendezvous weights (signals::rendezvous, seed 0) for key = FNV-1a(session_id) or else the prefix hash of the first 256 prompt tokens; all 1 when N <= 2; all 0 without a key
12-14 kv_load_ratio, active_prefill_ratio, active_requests_ratio = x/(eps + mean_S x) for features 4,3,5 with eps 0.01, 512/8192, 1/32
22 prefill_attn = n(L - n/2)/8192^2, n = new prefill tokens, L = prompt tokens
learned-choice.kv_capacity_fallback_used_in_replay: no (per facts/setup.json next_stage_notes: worker_capacity().total_kv_blocks() = 18863 in replay); the 65536 fallback is code-path only

parameters.context: optional: {p, q} (contract pooled form, rank len(p)) or {p, sources} (named form); absent/{}/empty p = no context
parameters.seed: optional u64; absent = fresh entropy per policy instance (harness must pass it)

learned-choice.utility: u_i = theta.x_i + sum_k c_k (p_k.x_i); c_k = q_k.mean_S(x) (pooled) or z_S[sources[k]] (named); computed as w = theta + sum_k c_k p_k, u_i = w.x_i; set aggregates summed in canonical worker order

sticky-session.behavior: no session id or first/forgotten session -> default cost fn choice (default scorer with the HOST config's weights; argmin, or the default's range-normalized softmax when host router_temperature > 0); hard -> bound worker whenever it is a candidate, else default choice + rebind; bounded -> bound worker unless its active_requests > load_factor * candidate mean active_requests, else default choice + rebind; host pin wins and rebinds; bounded LRU session map
sticky-session.composition: default cost scorer (host weights) + StickySessionPicker (declares LOAD), with_exclusive_affinity(true)

parameters.load_factor: bounded only (given with hard -> startup error); default 1.25; finite >= 1.0
